topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the key themes and learning objectives regarding cancer evolution, cellular origin, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to drive clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal tissue hierarchies, stemness, and specific cells of origin determine tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external microenvironmental signals and chronic inflammatory stimuli act as essential promoters that enable mutated cells to progress toward malignancy.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironment and Profiling Technologies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore stromal and immune codependencies in established tumors alongside the experimental and spatial technologies used to profile them.

topics.label: Integrative Synthesis of Cancer Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic unifies genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors into an overarching model of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session with brief housekeeping and a preview of the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
